{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Identify rows where baseline or final is sentinel (-999.0)
has_sentinel = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) | (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)

# Now compute mean change by arm, excluding sentinel cases
trial_df_clean = trial_df[~has_sentinel]
mean_change_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Check if the groups are comparable
print('Group sizes (excluding sentinel cases):')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm').size())
print('\n')

# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity to check for imbalance
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['severity']))
print('\n')

# Cross-tabulate arm vs sex
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['sex']))
print('\n')

# Cross-tabulate arm vs assay_batch
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs assay_batch:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['assay_batch']))
print('\n')

# Check age distribution by arm
print('Age by arm (mean):')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['age'].mean())"}
